subject: general
question: Famous instrumentalist, Lakshminarayana is renowned for playing which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Violin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lakshminarayana

 
 
• L. Subramaniam is a famous "violin player".
 
• In addition to composing symphonies and Carnatic pieces, Subramaniam has composed works for orchestras, ballets, and Hollywood film scores, and composed music books – such as Euphony.
 
• In 1992 he began the Lakshminarayana Global Music Festival.
 
• In 2007, the Subramaniam Foundation, a charity managed by Subramaniam and his wife, founded a music school in Bangalore, India called the Subramaniam Academy of Performing Arts (SAPA).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **violin **

 
 
• The violin is a string instrument that has four strings and is played with a bow.
 
• The strings are usually tuned to the notes** G, D, A, **and **E**.
 
• A person who makes or repairs violins is called a** luthier**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/CzJypOn3uzoot3yN4YyN0Zhk0maz3WIocxttF-n6Aq7JOSYJNL1JnivNzEry4nf_SA69c9wmfhXcUQtQ5ZfCA2lK_n2_SC2wtVQPDeKgrEumaoKEYKOn5M4_c3plfHXuScZ97urNQF539k2QLfupJj8ZLMfeqOjCkokF__eVSHsu1LEe1RSQuuugJ6xJ4Q] 

 

 
• Veena
 
 
• The veena is among the** oldest Indian musical** instruments.
 
• Temple sculptures from the** 2nd century B.C.** show a type of veena being played.
 
• The Saraswati veena is the predominant **Carnatic music** and the **Rudra veena** is the most played veena in **Hindustani music**.
 
• The Saraswati veena has seven strings strung over **twenty-four fixed frets**.
 
• The Hindu Goddess of Knowledge, **Saraswathi,** is said to play the Veena.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/lyHJ4pwN1tBYxGkO_6gaElb1FNHOLopNuUYG5BZdAzVyBSSOc239J8qBCoRy8E6LoRFF_F7NfshdAANFK61viaBk_XHdQ1yM-PRwqijLKR54hPzaiPdZMz-w1zoH1FF6dHdIVptPdVaptrYw_Vo7kp9WiqmEiN7ULUEzk-ZGPg1fIMtsHQIx3v8Ruttlbw] 

 
• Santoor:

 
 
• It is a trapezoid-shaped hammered dulcimer instrument.
 
• It is a traditional instrument of the UT of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
 

​ [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/8AlM8IaYwdt1tXjQJ4jIxrMrPNcisojKRVqB1E8CqbExJSXMk70oPI9BqOTFf6OgiMp4Kqi7O2NMxHBz9CQdPo_JGU3Bjsy39ZajIGYGFCFeSVxjq3lPeCWpWu6a7_x9wrtaRdR8SN5cC-7NaXNgQyJNYwCTICP6rnKrnCUJlEsKFN2tHeHji25v1TJpjg] 

 
• Sitar -

 
 
• It is one of the famous Indian musical instruments and it was developed by Amir Khusro.
 
• The sitar is a complete Indian instrument because it has all the three characteristics of Indian instruments.
 
• The famous Indian sitar player is Pandit Ravishankar, Nishat Khan, Debu Choudhary, Shujjat, Akhan, Imrat Khan, Shamim Ahmed Khan, etc.
